parsed.refutation_attempt: I examined the code for any checks that could mitigate a too-small buffer allocation: the only place where src_len is used is in the malloc call on line 26. No bounds checks or comparisons involving src_len appear before or after the allocation, and the decoding loop does not reference src_len at all. I also looked for any defensive handling around the decoding writes (lines 50, 53, 56, 58) but found none that would limit writes to the allocated space. Therefore the vulnerability cannot be refuted by existing checks.
